summary: Renames formatPrice to formatMoney with a currency parameter using Intl.NumberFormat, and threads a currency default through invoiceLines.

findings.title: Removed formatPrice still imported by cart.ts
findings.problem: The change renames formatPrice to formatMoney but src/cart.ts line 1 still imports formatPrice. cartTotal at src/cart.ts line 8 still calls formatPrice.
findings.consequence: The build fails on the missing export. Every caller of cartTotal breaks.
findings.fix: Update cart.ts to import formatMoney and call formatMoney(addTax(subtotal, taxRate), "USD"). Or keep formatPrice as a wrapper around formatMoney.

findings.title: New currency formatting has no covering test
findings.problem: formatMoney now accepts a currency and formats through Intl.NumberFormat with grouping separators. No test file in the repository exercises formatMoney or invoiceLines.
findings.consequence: A wrong currency code throws a RangeError at runtime and nothing catches that before release. Output for amounts over 999 now contains commas, which no test pins down.
findings.fix: Add tests for formatMoney with USD and a non-USD currency, and for invoiceLines with the default currency.
